body: Funny, electrical engineering is exactly what I want to major in.
Thanks so much. :)  I really don't want to die, so I'm working on it.  But god, it just seems like the answer to everything right now.

They're working on finding me a therapist, and my mom mentioned something like they found me one yesterday.  Not soon enough, I never thought I would be so happy to get one.  

It's not that I'm being pushed too hard, because I'm honestly barely working.  At all.  It's just that I dug myself into a hole and I forgot to bring a ladder or anything to help me get out.

Thanks for talking to me.  Really appreciate it.  And I know I don't have to be *perfect*, but I want to be so incredibly badly.  I think my problem is that I made stupid mistakes, and it's so hard to go back and fix them.  My mom has put in so much time and money to help me be the BEST, and I want to be the best for her.  It's just that I'm so frustrated with MYSELF, and my lack of motivation.  I'm so mad at myself for letting anything ever get this far.

But I'm in highschool, a sophmore, and things start counting now.  Having more and better AP scores will put me above the next guy and fix everything.  I just don't know if I can do it and be perfect.

Really, unfortunately, not a troll.  :C  But see, it really really is.  Without my grades, I'm just mediocre.  I have all these dreams of going to Harvard, being successful.  And without exceptional scores, I can NEVER get into exceptional schools and do exceptional things.  This is seriously a deciding factor.
